اقترضتما (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَضْتُمَا (iqtaraḍtumā) /iq.ta.radˤ.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# اُقْتُرِضْتُمَا (uqturiḍtumā) /uq.tu.ridˤ.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
